paper_reference.title: Fully Integrated 2.2-mW CMOS Front End for a 900-MHz Wireless Receiver

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC operating point, voltage gain, and bandwidth of the common-source amplifier.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Common-Source Amplifier Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u

* DUT
XM1 LABEL_NET_1 LABEL_NET_3 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}

* Sources and Load
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
RL VDD LABEL_NET_1 20k
V_in LABEL_NET_3 0 DC 0.6 AC 1

.control
* DC Operating Point
op
let id = -i(VVDD)
let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
print id power

* AC Analysis
ac dec 100 1k 100G
let gain_db = vdb(LABEL_NET_1)
meas ac midband_gain find gain_db at=10k
let target_gain = midband_gain - 3
meas ac bw when gain_db=target_gain fall=1

quit
.endc
